# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Charts — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 13 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Size — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #1c2023);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #1c2023 | Cards, panels, tables, sidebar, top bar and inputs (containers). |
| `--surface-elevated` | #faf9f6 | #282c31 | Dialogs, menus, popovers, table header rows and hover rows. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #24262a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text, #f1efe9);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #24262a;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #24262a | #f1efe9 | Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-elevated` (13:1+ light, 12:1+ dark). |
| `--text-secondary` | #777a80 | #a9aaad | Labels, captions, metadata. Dark: 6:1+ on every ground. Light: 3.7:1 on `bg`, 4.3:1 on `surface` — below 4.5:1 for small text (source value kept); prefer it on `surface` and at 13px+. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css

color: var(--on-gold, #17191c);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-gold, #17191c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */

```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-gold` | #17191c | #17191c | Text and icons on a `gold` fill (charcoal on gold, 9.2:1). Never white on gold. |
| `--on-gold-tint` | #24262a | #d6b77a | Label on `gold-tint`: charcoal text in light (14:1), gold in dark (7.0:1). |

## Color · Charts

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--chart-1, #c4912a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--chart-1, #bc8a26);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #c4912a;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--chart-1` | #c4912a | #bc8a26 | Chart series 1 — gold, the primary series (this period, the series the story is about). Deeper than `gold` so marks hold on white; 2.8:1 on light `surface`, so light-mode charts carry direct labels or a table view. |
| `--chart-2` | #2563d9 | #3b82f6 | Chart series 2 — blue. Assign series in fixed order 1→4; never reorder by rank. |
| `--chart-3` | #d6338a | #e0509e | Chart series 3 — magenta. Slots 1–3 are distinguishable in any combination (validated all-pairs, colour-blind safe), so line charts use at most these three. |
| `--chart-4` | #3838b8 | #8b7bff | Chart series 4 — indigo. Only for bars and donut segments, where it never touches `chart-2` (validated adjacent pairs incl. the donut's wrap-around). |
| `--chart-muted` | #c9c7c0 | #4a4f57 | De-emphasised data: the comparison period (last year) and the "Other" bucket. Series 5+ fold into it, never a new hue. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--gold, #d6b77a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--gold, #d6b77a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #d6b77a;
```

### Tokens (13)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--gold` | #d6b77a | #d6b77a | Champagne Gold, the signature accent. Primary button fill, active nav indicator, selected rows, primary chart series, logo. Never a large background and never small text on light grounds (1.7:1 on ivory) — use `gold-ink` there. |
| `--gold-hover` | #e2c995 | #e2c995 | Hover state of gold actions (primary button, gold toggles). |
| `--gold-pressed` | #b99a5e | #b99a5e | Pressed/active state of gold actions. |
| `--gold-ink` | #9c7b40 | #d6b77a | Gold for text, icons and links. Light: darker gold #9C7B40 — 3.4:1 on `bg`, 3.9:1 on `surface`: meets 3:1 for icons, focus rings and text 24px+, NOT 4.5:1 for body-size text (source value kept). Dark: 9.4:1 on `bg`, 8.5:1 on `surface`. |
| `--gold-tint` | #f9f5ec | #2f2f2c | Selected tile/option background (Selector), behind a `gold-ink` border. Assumption: 14% gold over `surface` (light), 10% (dark). |
| `--charcoal` | #17191c | #17191c | Brand Charcoal. Dark logo ground, splash screen, structure in brand moments. Same in both themes. |
| `--ivory` | #f1efe9 | #f1efe9 | Brand Warm Ivory. Light logo ground and marketing backgrounds. Same in both themes. |
| `--bg` | #f1efe9 | #141619 | App background behind sidebar, top bar and content. |
| `--focus-ring` | #9c7b40 | #d6b77a | 2px keyboard focus outline on every control, offset 2px. 3:1+ on all grounds in both themes. |
| `--success` | #43876a | #43876a | Positive status: in stock, completed, positive trend. Dot, icon, chart line or badge marker — always with a word or icon, never colour alone. As text it misses 4.5:1 in both themes. |
| `--warning` | #c18b42 | #c18b42 | Warnings and low-stock states. Marker colour only; pair with the word ("Low stock") and the `warning` icon. |
| `--danger` | #c45d58 | #c45d58 | Errors, out-of-stock, destructive actions (danger button fill with white text, 4.2:1 — bold 14px label), negative trend. |
| `--info` | #5c83a8 | #5c83a8 | Informational states: incoming stock, pending, notices. Marker colour only. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 32px/40px "Poppins", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-brand);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 32px / 40px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `brand` | Onboarding, splash, marketing headlines. |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 26px / 34px | 600 | `brand` | One per screen, top of the content area. |
| `section-title` | `.section-title`, `--text-section-title` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `brand` | Major sections within a page. |
| `card-title` | `.card-title`, `--text-card-title` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `ui` | Card and dialog titles. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `ui` | Default UI text, table cells, form values. |
| `secondary` | `.secondary` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `ui` | Helper text, metadata, secondary table columns. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `ui` | Labels, table headers, badges. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `ui` | Buttons and nav items. |
| `kpi` | `.kpi`, `--text-kpi` | 32px / 38px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `ui` | Dashboard figures (28–32px). Always tabular numerals. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `--font-brand` | `"Poppins", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `ui` | `--font-ui` | `"Manrope", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `icon` | `--font-icon` | `"Material Symbols Rounded"` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-4);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-4` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, badge padding. |
| `--space-8` | 8px | Gap inside controls, between stacked labels and inputs. |
| `--space-12` | 12px | Button horizontal padding (small), table cell vertical padding. |
| `--space-16` | 16px | Card padding (compact), gap between form fields. |
| `--space-24` | 24px | Card padding, gap between cards. |
| `--space-32` | 32px | Gap between page sections. |
| `--space-48` | 48px | Content area outer margin on wide screens. |
| `--space-64` | 64px | Onboarding and splash layouts. |

## Shadow

Restrained: borders carry structure, shadows only lift. Values are an assumption — the guidelines ask for restraint but give none.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,25,28,0.06) in the light theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px rgba(23,25,28,0.06) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30) | Cards, with a `border` outline. |
| `--shadow-dialog` | 0 16px 48px rgba(23,25,28,0.16) · dark: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.50) | Dialogs, menus and popovers. |
